newsitem.title: USA: Spa Faucet terminates Harmat merger pact.
newsitem.headline: Spa Faucet terminates Harmat merger pact.

text.p: Spa Faucet Inc said Wednesday it will terminate its previously signed letter of intent to be acquired by Harmat Organization due to what it called "overwhelming" opposition "from shareholders and from organizations."

"Although Spa management continues to believe in the long-term benefits of the agreement, it would be irresponsible for us to ignore the significance of the opinions of such a large number of our public shareholders," Leonardo Sudman, president, said in a statement.
The merger pact was announced April 8. One Harmat preferred share was to be swapped for each six Spa common shares.
